description: PowrSym4 jointly simulates generation, hydropower, renewables, electricity transmission and natural-gas systems. It dispatches resources to serve electricity, gas and heat demands and can represent uncertain inputs through risk curves. The provider is Operation Simulation Associates. Coverage: The provider describes hourly operation over study periods from weeks to several years. Regional configurations and input vintages are case-specific. Access: The provider supplies model descriptions and user-documentation links and offers software and services. No model package or service was obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The current page describes ongoing additions to reporting. Those developments and provider application claims were not independently checked. For simulation it supports coupled-resource dispatch and risk-aware system planning. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers PowrSym.
